tasks.short: Take and record hydroelectric water-level, temperature and flow readings.

steps.what: Take actual local water-level, temperature or flow readings and capture uninstrumented facts
outputs: actual technician-produced field readings with point, time and units

steps.what: Transfer already recorded historian water-level, temperature and flow data to recording drafts
inputs: actual existing historian tag, timestamp, value, unit and quality
actual approved hydropower point and interval mapping

steps.what: Assemble actual field and instrument readings using native round and equipment identifiers
inputs: actual technician-produced field readings with point, time and units

steps.what: Check final readings, source quality, water-level references, flow units and recording destination
inputs: actual field readings and historian sources

steps.what: Commit final actual water-level, temperature and flow readings record

tasks.design: Use native rounds/historian links first, then transfer actual existing hydropower historian {DATA_PLATFORM} values into rounds records {OPS_SYSTEM} where manual re-keying remains. Keep local reading capture, source/units checking and a separate final record commit; no equipment control changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recording may re-key instrument values and repeat round identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing historian fields and native rounds records support source-linked entry.
tasks.still_hard: Actual local conditions, bad sensors and reference-level meaning require technicians.
tasks.human_edge: The technician spots an implausible level reading against actual local conditions.
tasks.altitude: Remove real duplicate readings entry while retaining actual rounds.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing historian data can populate rounds records where available; actual uninstrumented readings require human capture.

assumptions: Provisional shares, not measured. Existing instrument/historian producer supplies point/tag, timestamp/timezone, value, unit, datum/reference where relevant and quality; reject stale, missing or mismatched values to manual reading/entry. No inferred measurements.

Actual technician takes and captures field readings in s1. Instrumented and field branches represent distinct actual points/required checks; never count one reading twice. Remove unused branch and reweight; no historian access means no s2 saving.

Savings require actual duplicate entry or repeated identifier work. Existing native integration/prefill earns zero new saving. Any actual report delivery, escalation or control action is separately final-version/state gated, with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Which water/temperature/flow values are already recorded and re-keyed?
research_questions: Can native transfer remove duplicate entry after full source and datum checks?

incremental.description: Maintain hydropower point, datum and unit mappings and review missing-data exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final actual hydropower readings and record destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25 duplicate transfer+15*0.50 repeated assembly=32.5 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual readings, full checking and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce actual duplicate hydropower readings entry while retaining field observation and verification.
role.ambitious_version: Source-linked hydropower readings and actual field observations form a checked record under technician control.
